title: Man Jumping into Pool
description: A large heavy man with a black swim cap is captured mid-air as he jumps into a swimming pool with arms outstretched and a smile on his face. His hands are not touching anything, the setting is an outdoor pool area at dusk with a diving board above, colorful pool noodles floating in the glowing turquoise water, and a single purple swim fin visible underwater near his reflection.
prompt: A large heavy man with a black swim cap and purple swim briefs is captured mid-air jumping into a swimming pool with arms outstretched and a smile on his face, water ripples and splashes below, colorful pool noodles floating in the glowing turquoise water, a purple swim fin visible underwater, outdoor pool area at dusk with a diving board above, realistic painting style with vibrant colors and reflections
